brand: Tutor Time with Teacher Cassie & Popcorn Math

popcornMath.type: In-person, hands-on after-school mathematics enrichment programme
popcornMath.targetAges: Primary school students (Grades 1 to 5, approx ages 6 to 11)
popcornMath.format: Mixed grades in one classroom for 1 hour per week
popcornMath.activities: Tactile manipulatives, 3D geometric constructions (such as tetrahedrons, cubes, and polyhedra), and hands-on mathematical problem solving
popcornMath.takeHome: Every single session ends with each child taking home an item they personally built
popcornMath.seriesDuration: 8 to 10 weeks within a school term
popcornMath.pricing: Paid per series (exact pricing confirmed upon registration enquiry; no invented prices)
popcornMath.pilotStatus: Planned pilot in January at the founder's school, with planned expansion across all six primary schools on Anguilla

presenters.role: Independent session presenters (trained to deliver Teacher Cassie's hands-on math crafts)
presenters.whoCanApply: School teachers, qualified educators, and young adults (ages 18-19) completing secondary education
presenters.materials: All materials packets provided; Teacher Cassie crafts the demonstration model in advance
presenters.safeguarding: Background checks required; presenters must adhere to a strict Code of Conduct
presenters.compensation: Paid per completed session with an attendance bonus for attending all sessions in a series

traditionalTutoring.name: Personalised Tutoring & Academic Support
traditionalTutoring.description: Tailored one-to-one and small group learning aligned with individual curriculum goals across core primary subjects

conciergeCoaching.name: Concierge Academic Coaching
conciergeCoaching.description: Comprehensive academic oversight, assignment tracking, study routines, and executive functioning support

specialistSupport.name: Individualised Learning Support
specialistSupport.description: Supporting students who benefit from differentiated instruction, structured routines, and personalised academic approaches

readinessCheck.name: CPEA Readiness Check
readinessCheck.description: Gamified mock-exam sample questions for students preparing for the Caribbean Primary Exit Assessment (Language Arts, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies)
readinessCheck.disclaimer: Sample questions: not an official CPEA paper.
